bitmapPublication: Only after original usage.decoded(next_decodes, bytes), before original infallible slot.set(entry), using original function identity. Failed scans, rejected scan publication, partial builds and rejected resident insertion cannot set a bit.

firstRejectedDebit.sticky: Set on first Err returned by original work_with_wasi only; never overwritten by later sticky-failure retries. Cancellation from a non-work check need not create a rejected-debit record.

functionRangeControl: Original profile rejects 79967 definitions at limit79966. With34 imports, actual accepted upper index79999 is exercised. Synthetic80000 telemetry invalidates separately; original validation is never relaxed.
identity: At original SwiftMode::meter entry, retain exact absolute function identity and whether its completed-decode bit was already set. Entry records do not set bits.
invalidBehavior: Sticky diagnostic invalidity only. Never maps to a guest error, changes a guest Result, authorizes execution, discounts work, expands budgets, changes owners or changes original precedence. After invalidity, aggregates are unusable for attribution even if individual fields remain useful for debugging.

invalidMask.4: invalid semantic site/event, identity context mismatch, or matching plan without prior completion

invariantsWhenValid: sum all 16 successful site credits equals original cumulative cache_work
scan/build first plus repeated credit and call partitions equal the corresponding site totals
scan first plus repeated publications equal plan event 3
distinct plus repeated completions equals both observed completed and original cache decodes
bitmap population equals distinct completed identities
a matching plan hit in normal fixtures requires an earlier completed decode
lifecycle: Reset once before a fresh isolated cache construction. Preserve state for constructed, Initialize, Corpus 1, Corpus 2 if reached and final consuming-cleanup snapshots in any separately authorized future driver. No such driver or full run is selected here.

memory.exclusions: RefCell/TLS machinery, compiler stack temporaries, test-fixture allocations, allocator/process overhead and stdout runtime are outside these Rust value sizes and outside original product reservations. No RSS, peak-memory, CPU or net overhead claim.

output.firstRejectionOptionalIdentityEncoding: u64::MAX means None; valid function indices and offsets are bounded far below it
output.kindAndResourceEncoding: Debug text of source-bound closed Rust enum variants, including Option/Reservation wrappers
output.scope: One fixed aggregate snapshot per externally selected lifecycle, not per-guest-loop output. Formatter returns false and invalidates diagnostics on insufficient output capacity. Caller must never use that boolean as VM authority.

partitions.meaning: The partition is fixed at meter entry; first means no prior completed IR decode, not first-ever attempted scan. Partial failed-operation successful credits remain included.

preserved: Original debit/check ordering, count validation, policy, Frozen behavior, failure values/precedence, exact allocations, memory/ticket/work/deadline limits, owner publication and consuming cleanup. Generic callbacks are cfg(test) default no-op; shared decoder and legacy implementation bytes remain unchanged.
scope: TEST ONLY; fixed external telemetry in owned accepted source clone; no production selection
successfulDebitSeam: Call original checkpoint then original work_with_wasi unchanged; observe returned Ok afterward. No rejected requested debit enters successful credits/calls. Return original Result unchanged.
